# Zan SDK

Zan is a modern systems programming language: C#-style syntax, an LLVM backend,
ARC memory management, and a standard library distributed as `.zan` sources.
This folder is a complete, self-contained SDK — run `ZanIDE.exe`, or use
`toolchain\zanc.exe` from a terminal. No installation step.

Compile a program:

```
toolchain\zanc.exe <file.zan> --auto-stdlib -o out.exe
```

## Docs

- [AI onboarding](docs/AI_ONBOARDING.md): connect an AI coding tool to Zan — how an agent works correctly without crawling sources.
- [Tooling](docs/TOOLING.md): the language server (`zan-lsp`) and debug adapter (`zan-dap`) — what they speak and how to drive them.
- [MCP hosting](docs/MCP_HOSTING.md): run `tools\zan-mcp.exe` over stdio or HTTP, knowledge file layout.
- [AI-assisted development](docs/ai-assist.md): AI-assisted development in Zan.
- [AI dev infrastructure (CN)](docs/AI_DEV_INFRASTRUCTURE.md): the general scheme for agent-assisted development in the Zan ecosystem.
- [AI_README.md](AI_README.md) (中文): overview of every AI integration path and when to use which.

## Rules

- [ai/AGENTS.md](ai/AGENTS.md): rules for any AI agent working in a Zan project (look APIs up before using them, verify with the compiler, workspace conventions).

## Knowledge (machine-readable)

- [knowledge/symbols.json](knowledge/symbols.json): standard-library symbol index, one entry per type/member.
- [knowledge/gallery.seed.json](knowledge/gallery.seed.json), [knowledge/zform.doc.json](knowledge/zform.doc.json): component gallery seed and `.zform` designer control docs.

## Skills

- [ai/skills/](ai/skills/): agent skills shipped with the SDK (game-dev, game-online, gui-design, zan-development, zan-debugging, zan-mcp, …).

## Layout

- `ZanIDE.exe` — the IDE (double-click to start; keep it next to the folders below)
- `toolchain/` — `zanc.exe` (compiler), `zan-lsp.exe`, `zan-dap.exe`, `zanfmt.exe`, `zandoc.exe`, `repomap.exe`, `ld.exe`, cross-target drivers and sysroots
- `stdlib/` — standard library sources
- `templates/` — project templates (console, gui, game, server, …)
- `examples/` — runnable example programs
- `tools/` — `zan-mcp.exe` and other dev tools
- `ai/` — agent onboarding pack: `AGENTS.md`, MCP client configs, skills
